newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill initiates ACC.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill initiates ACC.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Megan Kulick said she initiated ACC Corp as an intermediate-term accumulate and a long-term buy.
-- She said her 18-month price objective for ACC is $31. The stock stood at 24-3/4 in early trading Wednesday, up 1-1/4 points from the previous day's close.

-- In published remarks, she said ACC is well positioned to capture market share in deregulated telecom markets in the United States, Canada and Europe. "We expect rapid growth for several years as a result," she wrote.
-- She said ACC was an attractive consolidation candidate.
-- She put a private market value of $38 on ACC, based on discounted cash flow analysis, which translates into a 1998 revenue multiple of 1.5 times.
-- Kulick forecast total revenues of $385 million for 1997 and $481 million of 1998, or growth of 25 percent for both years.
-- Her 1997 year earnings per share estimate is $1.18, more than three times 1996's $0.34 per share. She estimated 1998 earnings would grow to $1.53 per share.
